summary: JSON list output must be [] (never null or hint text) when results are empty; result slices that feed a JSON encoder are initialized with make(..., 0) instead of a nil var declaration.
reason: Five commands (articles, open-access, search, trends, reading-list ls) wrote a human-readable hint to stderr and returned nil with no stdout output when the local corpus was empty; this left stdout empty and caused json_fidelity dogfood tests to fail with 'invalid JSON'. Also added Example field to reading-list ls which was missing. Follow-up: reading-list ls, feedback recent, and doctor's cache report encoded a nil slice directly, emitting null instead of [] for empty lists.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood gate passes with 0 failures after this fix.
